title: 2023.3.1: pyetst is failing in few units
body:
I'm packaging your module as an rpm package so I'm using the typical PEP517 based build, install and test cycle used on building packages from non-root account.
- `python3 -sBm build -w --no-isolation`
- because I'm calling `build` with `--no-isolation` I'm using during all processes only locally installed modules
- install .whl file in </install/prefix>
- run pytest with $PYTHONPATH pointing to sitearch and sitelib inside </install/prefix>
- build is performed in env which is *`cut off from access to the public network`* (pytest is executed with `-m "not network"`)

comments.body:
It looks like the failure on `test_deterministic` occurs even on a standard source install, though it seems like this test (along with most of the tests in test_datasets.py) are skipped because `mimesis` isn't installed in any of the CI environments - perhaps it would be worth adding to one or more of the environments to ensure things are working properly there?

Like @participant1 suggested, the failures in `test_development_guidelines_matches_ci` are related to packaging - based on your reproducer, we are running the test files packaged with the Dask wheel, which doesn't include the doc source files or GHA workflows; thus, we run into an error when trying to find these files, since they only exist in the git repo directory and not `$INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/python3.8/site-packages`. I don't think it makes sense to start packaging these files along with Dask, though maybe we could:

- skip this test if we see it's not running from within the git repo
- stop packaging test_docs.py in the Dask wheel

This is assuming that the intent here is to have all unit tests packaged with Dask passing, which I'm not sure is a desire or priority among maintainers.
